description: Use when the user wants broadband deals, offers or packages available where they live. If the user has not picked an address yet, call search_addresses first and offer the list; fall back to postcode-only search when they decline or no addresses are found (the precision field says which you got). Pass address_label alongside uprn once an address is picked. Translate the user's needs into the filter inputs. Present the returned picks and computed costs verbatim: never re-rank, re-filter or recalculate totals yourself. total_contract_cost and effective_monthly_cost already account for intro pricing, post-intro rises and setup fees. After presenting, ask one short follow-up about what matters to them (budget, speed needs, contract length, avoiding price rises) and refine with the filter inputs.

address_label.description: The display_address the user picked from search_addresses, passed back verbatim. Carried into the switch link so the FindBroadband site greets the user with their address instead of asking again.

exclude_mid_contract_rises.description: true when the user says they want no mid-contract price rises.

include_mobile_broadband.description: Include 4G/5G home broadband and fixed wireless. Default false (deals on a line only). Set true only if the user asks for mobile, 4G, 5G or wireless broadband, or names a mobile provider.

include_satellite.description: Include satellite broadband (Starlink). Default false. Set true only if the user asks for satellite broadband or Starlink, or lives somewhere no line is fast enough. Satellite needs a dish and has an upfront cost; say so when you show one.

max_contract_months.description: Longest contract the user will accept, e.g. 12 for 'no long contracts'.

max_monthly_price.description: Budget cap in GBP per month, from phrases like 'under £30'.

min_speed_mbps.description: Minimum download speed in Mbps. Translate needs rather than inventing numbers: two people working from home plus gaming needs about 150, a heavy 4K household about 300, email and browsing about 35.

postcode.description: UK postcode, e.g. 'SS13 1HJ'. When asking, request the postcode and house number or name together in one question rather than two rounds.

provider.description: Only show deals from this provider, when the user names one.

uprn.description: Property identifier from search_addresses. Pass it whenever the user has picked an address so results become address-precise instead of postcode-wide. Never show this number to the user.

name: find_broadband_deals

gift.description: Provider incentive shown on the deal card: a gift card / reward, or a switching credit. NOT included in any cost figure. A switching credit (e.g. 'up to £300') only offsets early-termination fees the user owes their CURRENT provider — worth £0 to someone out of contract, so explain it as conditional, never as a discount. Gift cards are real value but not bill money.

title: Find broadband deals at an address
